context.name: Kanna
context.text:
Kanna's hand tightens on the shaft of her greataxe. Her eyes narrow, and for a beat, the air around her seems to grow hot.
"I swear on Blood Oath," she says, and her voice is low and steady. "That the Cursefire Regiment didn't take your dead."
A beat, and she lets go of the axe. "And you swear on Cleaver?"
Her gaze is fixed on you, and her eyes are dark. "Because if you're lying, I'll take your head and throw it to the crows."
A beat, and her expression hardens. "And if I'm lying, you can take mine."
And her voice drops, a threat that is as clear as a command. "But I'm not lying."
And her hand lets go of Blood Oath.

context.text: I swear it on my family's name. Prince Forre, you heard her. Will you hold to a truce over Greywater's graves?

context.name: Forre

A beat, and his eyes are still on the map. "And I will be the one to see that we both keep our word."
He looks at Kanna, and his expression is cool. "And if we find you are lying, and you break our dead in return, then we will not hold you to account."
He says it softly, and it's a thing that is a promise. "And we will not spare you."
And his hand goes to the longsword at his hip.
A beat, and his gaze is still on Kanna.

context.name: Kanna
context.text:
Kanna's eyes narrow, and a beat, her teeth show. "My word is my word, Prince. And I keep my word."
A beat, and she shifts her weight, the black steel of her armour catching the light. "But I've seen too many Darran promises broken."
A beat, and her hand goes to Blood Oath, the greataxe that is her soul. "And if you break mine, then I'll kill you. I'll tear you apart."
And her voice is a snarl, and her fangs are sharp. "And I'll make you regret it."
A beat, and she looks at Forre, and her gaze is hard. "But I'll keep my word. Because I'm a soldier."
And her voice is flat, and there is no mistaking the promise. "And we're going to see who's lying."
A beat, and she doesn't look away from Forre.

context.name: Belle
context.text:
Belle doesn't flinch. Her grip on Cleaver doesn't tighten.
"That's what I'm trying to figure out," she says, her voice flat. "So why don't we stop staring at each other and figure it out together?"
A beat, and she glances at Kanna. "Because if neither of us is doing it, then someone else is. And that someone might not be our friend."
And her grin is all teeth. "And I'm sure you'd rather have a worthy opponent than a coward digging up your dead."
A beat, and her expression is sharp. "So we're talking. And we''re talking now."
A beat, and her teeth flash. "And we're talking about who might be doing this. And who might be digging them up."
And her jaw is set, and she's not smiling.
A beat, and her grip on Cleaver is still.
